title: Between Proof and Prose
description: A mathematician who researches, teaches, and writes.
intro: I study transcendental number theory, teach students who love mathematics, and write about the moments in between. This is a space where proofs and prose quietly coexist.

list.p: Records of daily life, seasons, and the people I meet along the way.
Thoughts on transcendental number theory, seminars, and the beauty of proof.
